notes:
The made-up PDFs use a font that is not embedded, which PDF/A cannot take as pages, so both travelled attached (the documented exception). A person tries a PDF with embedded fonts and an image for the page appendix.
An image Document and a Company's internal Documents (not included) were not made by script; a person checks them.
A person confirms the image pages and that a Company's internal Documents are left out. The script found the PDF Documents carried (attached, see notes), the DWG embedded in the PDF and the Documents listed.
